steps.what: Show the stored test information for this design.
Interpret test information to resolve design related problems.

tasks.design: The {DATA_PLATFORM} shows the test information already recorded. The engineering technician interprets it and resolves the design-related problem. The figure does not name the cause. A station that already recorded the test is not this time. Only the interpretation the technician accepts is filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: A design was marked resolved because a test id existed, and nobody had interpreted the information.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored test information can be opened. The interpretation and the resolution still belong to the technician.
tasks.still_hard: A cause the figure does not show still has to be found by the technician.
tasks.human_edge: The technician interprets the test. The figure is not the resolution.
tasks.altitude: The interpretation stays with the technician. It is filed only after that version is accepted.

reach.task: Use an interpretation this technician has accepted.
reach.learn: A test id is not the design fix.

evidence.claim: Opening stored test information is a lookup. It does not interpret the test or resolve a design-related problem.
Time a test station already spends recording the figure is not the technician's interpretation.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An engineering technician in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the circuit, and a draft is not the accepted record.

Fields: The test id and the information already recorded. The interpretation is not added by the screen. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the engineering technician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the test information. Do not treat the figure as the cause.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the engineering technician.
A test station, drawing tool, controller, bill generator, or statistical program that already runs is not in these shares.
unknowns: Whether every design-related problem has a stored test, or some have only a note.
research_questions: Who confirms the test information matches the design now being resolved?

already_counted.description: Interpreting the test and resolving the design problem stay with the technician.

incremental.description: Drop tests whose design record has been withdrawn.

approvals.approved_version: test id and the interpretation the technician accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The technician still interprets the test information and still resolves the design-related problem. Only opening information that was already recorded, and filing the interpretation already accepted, is removed. A test id saves none of that reading.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show stored prices, sources, and delivery times.
Research equipment needs from those stored prices.

tasks.design: The {ERP} shows the source, the price, the delivery time, and the operational cost when those fields are already stored. The engineering technician researches the equipment or component need from those fields. A price that is not stored is not invented. Only the comparison the technician accepts is filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: A competitive price was typed in with no source, and the comparison treated it as a quote.
tasks.enabler_now: Stored prices, sources, and delivery times can be opened. The research still belongs to the technician.
tasks.still_hard: A source the table does not list still has to be found by the technician.
tasks.human_edge: The technician researches the need. A missing price is not a price.
tasks.altitude: The research stays with the technician. The comparison is filed only after that version is accepted.

reach.task: Use a comparison this technician has accepted.
reach.learn: A missing price is not a quote.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored price, source, or delivery time is a lookup. It does not research the need or invent a competitive price.
Filing a comparison before the technician accepts that version would store a source nobody checked.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An engineering technician in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the circuit, and a draft is not the accepted record.

Fields: The part id and any price, source, delivery time, and operational cost already stored. A missing price is left missing. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the engineering technician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the stored prices. Do not invent a competitive price or a delivery time.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the engineering technician.
unknowns: Whether competitive prices and contracted prices share one table.
research_questions: Who confirms a stored price is still the supplier's price?

already_counted.description: Researching the equipment or component need stays with the technician.

incremental.description: Drop prices whose part record has been withdrawn.

approvals.approved_version: part id and the comparison the technician accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The technician still researches the equipment or component need, the source, the price, the delivery time, and the operational cost. Only opening figures that were already stored, and filing the comparison already accepted, is removed. A missing price saves none of that research.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the stored equipment and its installation record.
Provide engineering recommendations for equipment installation or upgrades.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the equipment and its installation record. The engineering technician provides the application support or the recommendation for installation, upgrade, or enhancement of new or existing equipment. The record does not choose the upgrade. Only the recommendation the technician accepts is filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: An upgrade was recommended from an equipment title, and the installation record was for a different unit.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored equipment record can be opened. The support and the recommendation still belong to the technician.
tasks.still_hard: A site the record does not describe still has to be heard from the user.
tasks.human_edge: The technician recommends. The equipment record is not the recommendation.
tasks.altitude: The support stays with the technician. The recommendation is filed only after that version is accepted.

reach.task: Use a recommendation this technician has accepted.
reach.learn: An equipment title is not the upgrade.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored equipment record is a lookup. It does not provide support or recommend an installation, upgrade, or enhancement.
Filing a recommendation before the technician accepts that version would store advice nobody gave.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An engineering technician in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the circuit, and a draft is not the accepted record.

Fields: The equipment id and the installation record already stored. The recommendation is not added by the screen. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the engineering technician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the equipment record before the recommendation.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the engineering technician.
unknowns: Whether new and existing equipment share one installation record.
research_questions: Who confirms the record matches the equipment the user has?

already_counted.description: Providing the support and the recommendation stays with the technician.

incremental.description: Drop records whose equipment has been withdrawn.

approvals.approved_version: equipment id and the recommendation the technician accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The technician still provides the application or engineering support and still recommends the installation, upgrade, or enhancement. Only opening an equipment record that was already stored, and filing the recommendation already accepted, is removed. A title saves none of that advice.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Compare stored production costs for sustainable and nonsustainable designs.
Conduct the statistical study and accept what the costs show.

tasks.design: The {DATA_PLATFORM} holds the production cost already stored for the sustainable design and for the nonsustainable design. The comparison subtracts those two figures, and a missing cost stops it. The engineering technician conducts the statistical study and accepts what the figures show. A statistical program that already runs is not this time. Only the study the technician accepts is filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: A design was called cheaper from a figure that had no stored cost behind it.
tasks.enabler_now: Two stored costs can be subtracted. The study of what that means still belongs to the technician.
tasks.still_hard: A cost the table does not hold still has to be left out, not invented.
tasks.human_edge: The technician conducts the study. The subtraction is not the conclusion.
tasks.altitude: The study stays with the technician. It is filed only after that version is accepted.

reach.task: Use a cost study this technician has accepted.
reach.learn: A subtraction is not the study.

evidence.claim: Subtracting two stored production costs is arithmetic. It does not conduct the statistical study or decide which design is sound.
A statistical program that already runs is not the technician's time, and a missing cost is not a cost.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An engineering technician in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the circuit, and a draft is not the accepted record.

Fields: The design id and the production cost already stored for each design. A missing cost stops the comparison. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the engineering technician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Subtract stored costs only. Do not invent a cost, and do not treat the statistical program's runtime as the study.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the engineering technician.
A test station, drawing tool, controller, bill generator, or statistical program that already runs is not in these shares.
unknowns: Whether sustainable and nonsustainable designs share one cost table.
research_questions: Who confirms both costs are for the same production measure?

already_counted.description: Conducting the statistical study stays with the technician.

incremental.description: Drop costs whose design record has been withdrawn.

approvals.approved_version: design ids, both costs, and the study the technician accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The technician still conducts the statistical study of the production costs for the sustainable and nonsustainable designs. Only subtracting costs that were already stored, and filing the study already accepted, is removed. A missing cost, and a program that already runs, save none of that study.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The engineering technician still interprets the test, still researches the source and the price, still recommends the equipment, and still reads the cost comparison. A stored figure can be opened. It does not make the judgement.
reach: Design engineers hear an interpretation this technician has accepted, and a test id is not that reading.
Buyers use a source comparison this technician has accepted, and a missing price is not a price.
skills_to_grow: Interpret the test. Do not treat a stored figure as the design fix.
Research a price only when it is already stored. Do not invent one.
Read a cost comparison. Do not treat a subtraction as the study.
role.ambitious_version: Interpretation, research, recommendations, and the cost study stay with the technician. Stored figures only show what was already recorded.
